provenance: Copy of orbit_seu/env_data/weibull_7series_measured.json for layout_ecc_sim downstream use. 28nm Xilinx 7-series FPGA heavy-ion Weibull cross-section, fitted from ground beam test (NOT synthetic). Source: Lee, Wirthlin, Swift, Le, REDW 2014, DOI 10.1109/REDW.2014.7004595, OSTI PURL https://www.osti.gov/servlets/purl/1140364. Device under test: XC7K325T-1FBG900C (Kintex-7, 28nm).

source.title: Single-Event Characterization of the 28 nm Xilinx Kintex-7 Field-Programmable Gate Array under Heavy Ion Irradiation
source.borrow_note: xc7vx690t (Virtex-7) shares identical 28nm 7-series CRAM cells; same-family borrow per handover doc section '源1'.

unit_note: Paper Table 1 'A' is um^2/bit. orbit_seu/layout_ecc expect cm^2/bit. sigma_sat_cm2_per_bit = sigma_sat_raw_um2_per_bit * 1e-8.
orbit_seu_weibull_formula: sigma(L) = sigma_sat * (1 - exp(-((L - let_threshold)/width)^shape)), L > let_threshold else 0

CRAM.source: Lee et al. 2014 Table 1, Config Memory row
CRAM.borrow: measured on XC7K325T; borrowed to xc7vx690t under same 28nm 7-series family

BRAM.source: Lee et al. 2014 Table 1, BRAM row
BRAM.borrow: measured on XC7K325T; borrowed to xc7vx690t under same 28nm 7-series family

FF.source: Lee et al. 2014 Table 1, User Flip-flop row
FF.borrow: measured on XC7K325T; borrowed to xc7vx690t under same 28nm 7-series family

layout_ecc_usage_note: M9 is wired: layout_ecc/weibull.py loads this file; GUI default flip_model=weibull uses σ(LET) in cm²/bit with kernel area in cm². DSP is absent here (gap). Do not mix UG116 neutron numbers into this heavy-ion curve.

gaps.UG116_neutron_FIT_crosscheck: DONE 2026-08-22 (see ug116_7series_neutron_seu.json crosscheck_performed_2026_08_22): independent Wirthlin JINST 2014 LANSCE values within 21%/10% of UG116 v10.20, and sigma x JESD89A NYC flux reproduces the UG116 realtime FIT order of magnitude (~2x). Heavy-ion sigma_sat vs neutron sigma stays a particle-species comparison (3 orders apart, expected).
gaps.proton_sigma_E_table: PARTIALLY FILLED 2026-08-22: proton_7series_sigma_E.json now carries measured TSL 180 MeV proton sigma (CRAM 8.29e-15, BRAM 8.19e-15 cm2/bit) from Wirthlin JINST 2014 Table 1; FF/DSP remain gaps and the file is not wired into any rate calculation.
gaps.xc7vx690t_per_domain_bits: use actual device bits in config; not fabricated. Independently re-verified 2026-08-22 against vendor originals: DS180 v2.6.1 (108,300 slices, 3,600 DSP, 52,920 Kb BRAM, 8 FF/slice -> 866,400 FF) and UG470 Table 1-1 (bitstream 229,878,496).
